title: Post-quantum KEM explorer: ML-KEM-768 against X25519
summary: Use a vetted ML-KEM-768 implementation to encapsulate and decapsulate a shared secret, then compare key sizes, ciphertext sizes, and operation latencies against an X25519 baseline you wrote in the ch05 project. Write up the operational tradeoffs.
deliverables: Working ML-KEM-768 encap/decap round-trip using a vetted library
Benchmark table: pubkey size, ciphertext size, encap latency, decap latency vs X25519
Short writeup of what a hybrid KEM (X25519 + ML-KEM) buys you in 2026
